title: Initial Heads in the Orbit Envelope
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-tape Turing machine, let $a\in S$, and let $R$ be a round contract for $M$ with anchor $a$. Suppose $c$ starts in state $a$, the precondition holds at every orbit configuration with index $r<n$, and each round endpoint with $r+1<n$ returns to state $a$. Then the vector of work-tape head positions in $c$ lies in the coordinatewise box whose lower and upper endpoints are, respectively, the minimum and maximum of the contract bounds at orbit indices below $n$ together with the head positions at orbit index $n$.
hypotheses_covered: A round contract $R$ for machine $M$ with anchor $a$
The precondition holds at every orbit index $r<n$
Every round endpoint with $r+1<n$ has state $a$
replaced:
Let $M$ be a multi-tape machine and let $R$ be a round contract with anchor $a$. Suppose
a configuration $c$ starts in state $a$, the round precondition holds at each orbit
configuration with index $r<n$, and every round endpoint with $r+1<n$ returns to $a$.
Then each work-head position of $c$ lies between the minimum and maximum, respectively,
of the contract bounds at orbit indices below $n$ together with the head positions at
orbit index $n$.
